title: Trump Has Peaked
gist: Video page for Ravi Agrawal's argument 'Trump Has Peaked'; the captured text contains no transcript, only the headline and FP related-content links (e.g., China winning the AI energy race, US munitions shortfall, global bond market stress), so extractable signal is limited to headline-level framing.

insights.claim: Foreign Policy editor in chief Ravi Agrawal argues, in a video segment, that Donald Trump's political power has peaked; the captured page includes no transcript of the supporting argument.
insights.so_what: If Trump's leverage is waning, markets may begin pricing reduced policy volatility and a post-Trump US policy path.
insights.speaker: Ravi Agrawal
